svg.title: Dependency diagram for masterDriver_PlotHazardCurvesTwoLocDiffT1
svg.desc: The driver runs five sections chosen by runHazardIndex. Each section calls a helper, and the helpers share core functions findHazVal v4, returnHazCurve v2 and getZoneFactor v1, which read hazard_20260818.mat.
svg.text: Teal = section on in runHazardIndex [1 1 0 0 0]; gray = off
